# create attend variable in w70

```{r}

#| label: create respond variable attend

library(nnet)
w70_cp <- w70 %>% 
  filter(F_RELIG %in% c(1,2)) %>% 
  filter(ATTENDMONTH_W70 != 99, ATTENDONLINE_W70 != 99) %>%
  mutate(attend = case_when(
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Both",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 1 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "In-person only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 1 ~ "Online only",
    ATTENDMONTH_W70 == 2 & ATTENDONLINE_W70 == 2 ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  mutate(attend = factor(attend, 
                         levels = c("In-person only", "Online only", "Both", "Neither")))
w70_cp$attend <- relevel(w70_cp$attend, ref = "In-person only")
table(w70_cp$attend)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ATTENDMONTH_W70 = attend mass in person
# ATTENDONLINE_W70 = attend mass online
#
# attend codes:
# 1 -> attend in person = 1, online = 1  (attend both)
# 2 -> attend in person = 1, online = 2  (only in person)
# 3 -> attend in person = 2, online = 1  (only online)
# 4 -> attend in person = 2, online = 2  (attend neither)
#
# Note: rows with v1 == 99 or v2 == 99 are removed
# ------------------------------------------------------------

```

# 12.2 update

```{r}
# function 
run_multinom_model <- function(data, outcome_var, predictor_vars, ref_level = "In-person only") {
  library(nnet)
  library(dplyr)
  
  # Step 1: remove 99
  data_clean <- data %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(predictor_vars), ~ . != 99))

  # Step 2: convert predictors to factor
  data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(predictor_vars), as.factor))

  # Step 3: set reference category for outcome
  data_clean[[outcome_var]] <- relevel(as.factor(data_clean[[outcome_var]]), ref = ref_level)

  # Step 4: drop predictors with only 1 level
  level_counts <- sapply(data_clean[, predictor_vars, drop = FALSE], nlevels)
  invalid_vars <- names(level_counts[level_counts <= 1])

  if (length(invalid_vars) > 0) {
    message("⚠️ Dropped variables (only 1 level): ",
            paste(invalid_vars, collapse = ", "))
  }

  valid_vars <- setdiff(predictor_vars, invalid_vars)

  # Step 5: build formula
  formula_obj <- as.formula(
    paste(outcome_var, "~", paste(valid_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )

  # Step 6: fit multinom model
  model <- multinom(formula_obj, data = data_clean)

  # Step 7: return model & summary
  list(
    model = model,
    summary = summary(model),
    valid_vars = valid_vars,
    dropped_vars = invalid_vars
  )
}
```

```{r}
# setup
w70_cp <- w70_cp %>%
  mutate(
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 == 99, NA, CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70),
    
    # recode: Yes=1, No=0, Not sure=0
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 == 1, 1, 0),
    CONGRESTRICT2_b_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 == 1, 1, 0),
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_rec = ifelse(CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 == 1, 1, 0),

    # combine: total restrictions
    CONGRESTRICT2_total_W70 = CONGRESTRICT2_a_rec +
                              CONGRESTRICT2_b_rec +
                              CONGRESTRICT2_c_rec
  )%>%
  mutate(
    # remove refused (optional)
    COVIDCONG3_W70 = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDCONG3_W70),

    # 1: not open
    COVIDCONG3_notopen = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 3, 1, 0),

    # 2: open with changes
    COVIDCONG3_open_changed = ifelse(COVIDCONG3_W70 == 2, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # remove refused
    COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 = ifelse(COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDTHREAT_a_W70),
    COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 = ifelse(COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 99, NA, COVIDTHREAT_b_W70),

    COVIDTHREAT_health_cat = case_when(
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 1 | COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 1 ~ 1, # major
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 2 | COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 2 ~ 2, # minor
      COVIDTHREAT_a_W70 == 3 & COVIDTHREAT_b_W70 == 3 ~ 3, # not a threat
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

  


w70_c <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(F_RELIG == 2)
w70_p <- w70_cp %>%
  filter(F_RELIG == 1)
```

```{r}
# helper: 众数函数
Mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- na.omit(unique(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}
data_base <- w70_c  # Catholic, Wave 70

base_vals <- data_base %>%
  summarise(
    COVIDCONG3_W70      = Mode(COVIDCONG3_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70 = Mode(CONGRESTRICT2_a_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70 = Mode(CONGRESTRICT2_b_W70),
    CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70 = Mode(CONGRESTRICT2_c_W70),
    CTKNOW1_W70         = Mode(CTKNOW1_W70),
    CONTACTTRAC1_W70    = Mode(CONTACTTRAC1_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_a_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_a_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_b_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_b_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_c_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_c_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_d_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_d_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_e_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_e_W70),
    SERMONISSUE_f_W70   = Mode(SERMONISSUE_f_W70)
  )
conf_levels <- res_w70c$model$xlevels$ATTENDCONF_W70
conf_levels

newdata <- expand.grid(
  ATTENDCONF_W70 = conf_levels
) %>%
  mutate(
    ATTENDCONF_W70 = factor(
      ATTENDCONF_W70,
      levels = conf_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  bind_cols(base_vals[rep(1, length(conf_levels)), ])

for (v in names(res_w70c$model$xlevels)) {
  newdata[[v]] <- factor(
    newdata[[v]],
    levels = res_w70c$model$xlevels[[v]]
  )
}

pred_probs <- predict(
  res_w70c$model,
  newdata = newdata,
  type = "probs"
)

plot_df <- bind_cols(newdata, as.data.frame(pred_probs)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = colnames(pred_probs),
    names_to = "attendance_type",
    values_to = "probability"
  )
ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = ATTENDCONF_W70,
           y = probability,
           color = attendance_type,
           group = attendance_type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Attendance Patterns by Confidence in Attending Safely\n(Catholic, Wave 70)",
    x = "Confidence in Attending In-Person Services Safely",
    y = "Predicted Probability",
    color = "Attendance Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+ scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "1" = "Very confident",
      "2" = "Somewhat confident",
      "3" = "Not too confident",
      "4" = "Not at all confident"
    )
  )+ theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# 构造 binned residual 数据（online only vs In-person only）

mf <- model.frame(res_w70c$model)
nrow(mf)
pred_probs_obs <- predict(res_w70c$model, type = "probs")

df_check <- mf %>%
  mutate(
    y_online = ifelse(attend == "Online only", 1, 0),
    p_online = pred_probs_obs[, "Online only"]
  )
library(arm)

binnedplot(
  x = df_check$p_online,
  y = df_check$y_online,
  nclass = 20,
  xlab = "Predicted probability (Online only)",
  ylab = "Average residual",
  main = "Binned residual plot: Online only vs In-person only"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

```

```{r}
# 构造 binned residual 数据（Both vs In-person only）

mf <- model.frame(res_w70c$model)

pred_probs_obs <- predict(res_w70c$model, type = "probs")


df_check_both <- mf %>%
  mutate(
    y_both = ifelse(attend == "Both", 1, 0),
    p_both = pred_probs_obs[, "Both"]
  )

binnedplot(
  x = df_check_both$p_both,
  y = df_check_both$y_both,
  nclass = 20,
  xlab = "Predicted probability (Both)",
  ylab = "Average residual",
  main = "Binned residual plot: Both vs In-person only"
)
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)

```
